WITH d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999
),
d23 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT i_item_id,
           i_item_desc,
           s_store_id,
           s_store_name,
           MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
           MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
           MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM store_returns AS r
    JOIN store_sales AS sales
      ON sales.ss_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk
     AND sales.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
     AND sales.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN catalog_sales AS cat
      ON cat.cs_bill_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk
     AND cat.cs_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
    JOIN d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN d23 AS d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = r.sr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN d23 AS d3
      ON d3.d_date_sk = cat.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store AS st
      ON st.s_store_sk = sales.ss_store_sk
    JOIN item AS it
      ON it.i_item_sk = sales.ss_item_sk
    GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       i_item_desc,
       s_store_id,
       s_store_name,
       store_sales_profit,
       store_returns_loss,
       catalog_sales_profit
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
